events.content:
Make a single-file HTML page with everything inline and no external assets.



  Create a clean, dark, elegant hero scene centered on one beautiful bowl of vegetarian ramen. The bowl should feel warm and inviting, with rich broth, noodles,
  and toppings. Add subtle steam rising from the bowl, and soft ambient lighting.



  Keep the composition simple: just the ramen bowl as the focal point. No menus, cards, buttons, or extra UI.



  Add very subtle motion so the scene feels alive: steam drifting upward, a slight shimmer on the broth, and tiny natural movements in the noodles or toppings.
  On hover or tap, gently disturb the broth with a soft ripple and slightly increase the steam for a moment.



  Make it responsive and polished on any screen, with tasteful motion and support for prefers-reduced-motion.



  Write the finished HTML file to index.html in the current working directory.

I’m building this as a self-contained illustration in HTML/CSS/SVG so it stays lightweight, editable, and truly asset-free. I’ll include hover/tap interaction, layered ambient light, and reduced-motion fallbacks.
